notes.title: Fix the bug that the game cannot start
notes.notes:
A major bug occurred during the update, which may cause some players to be unable to start the game.
It has been repaired.
Players who still can’t start the game can uninstall the game and reinstall it to play the game
We apologize for the inconvenience caused to you.

notes.title: Major update!
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Updated a hidden story to make the story more coherent and complete. There is not much pen and ink to hide the plot, but it conveys the core of the story and is worth experiencing!
[*] 
[*] Some tips have been updated. It is wrong to mislead people under the banner of simulator.
[/list]

This game is relatively simple, and the nature of experimental creation is the main one.
In fact, there is still a little content hidden, which will not be released before it is profitable.
Finally, thank you for your enthusiastic support ~ ~ We will meet again in the next game ~
